unit.why: The division holds a short anecdote about R. Meir being pressed by his brother of Kovel to 'say Torah' and his reply, a separate tale of the Besht appearing in a dream to his disciples after his death, and a closing saying about the author's master's Psalms commentary.
unit.boundary_note: the closing Psalms passage is a saying, not a narrative; the section heading 'מענין אמירת תורה' at the end of the previous division introduces this one

stories.start_quote: ומר אבי הג׳ הק׳ מוהר״ם נבג״מ
stories.summary_en: R. Meir rarely delivered Torah to visitors; when his brother, the tsaddik of Kovel, pressed him, he answered that the art is to bind oneself to the source of Torah so that words flow suited to each listener.

quotes: הפציר בו אחי הרה״ק מקאוולא זצ״ל
tags.why: his brother is the one pressing him

quotes: היה ממעט באמירת תורה להבאים אליו
tags.why: delivering Torah discourses is the subject
concerns how he treated visitors to his court

quotes: באופן שיושפעו ממנו דברי תורה לפי המדבר
tags.why: the tsaddik as a channel through whom Torah flows to each listener
he plays down the merit of saying Torah

missing_concepts: the tsaddik's reticence about delivering Torah
binding oneself to the root of Torah

stories.summary_en: After the Besht's death his disciples gathered over the teachings each had heard from him, and he appeared to them in a dream, rebuking them for attending to his Torah and not to his fear of Heaven.

tags.why: the Besht appears in a dream

quotes: ונראה להם הבעש״ט ז״ל בחלום ואמר להם
tags.why: the soul of the dead master speaks to them

quotes: נתאספו הכנופיא תלמידיו הק׳ על עניני התורה
tags.why: the disciples' relation to their dead master is central

quotes: ואין אתם נותנים לב להיראת שמים שהי׳ לי
tags.why: fear of Heaven is the point of the rebuke

quotes: למה אתם נותנים לב לדברי תורתי
tags.why: the master's Torah teachings are discussed

quotes: מעשה זו סיפר אדומו״ר זצל״ה באותו זמן
tags.why: the tale is framed as told by the author's master on a set occasion
a posthumous appearance of the master

missing_concepts: the priority of fear of Heaven over Torah teachings
